# Security policy

## Supported versions

Only the latest release gets fixes. Music Dedup updates itself, and the latest .dmg is always on the [Releases](https://github.com/mihaiflorinpopa/music-dedup/releases/latest) page.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please report it privately: open the repository's **Security** tab and choose **Report a vulnerability**. Please don't open a public issue for it.
